answer: Each claim must climb a trellis of its own verified jobs, and its payout is capped by that trellis's height. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, near zero, and must earn height over ten epochs of verified work; the record decays 10% each idle epoch, so keeping 10 clones fed costs 80 verified jobs every epoch. Every claim sends a ripple through the trellis, and peers read how far it travels: a ripple from copied work fades at the first rung, the claim drops, and its 85 POA fee is burned. One trellis feeds one identity; records cannot be grafted across clones.
